title: LazUnirec: Unifying Retrieval and Ranking in Multi-scenario Industrial Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2611.32590v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern industrial recommendation systems typically divide retrieval and ranking into two separate cascaded stages, leading to inconsistent optimization objectives, redundant encoding of user sequences, and a waste of computational resources. Previous efforts have investigated using Transformers to model both retrieval and ranking simultaneously. However, these studies still face two major limitations: (1) Since retrieval and ranking share a single Transformer backbone, the gradient conflict arises when the gradient directions of the two tasks are inconsistent. (2) When gradient conflict occurs, the model cannot determine a reliable direction for gradient updates. To this end, we propose a Unified Retrieval and Ranking approach for Multi-scenario Industrial Recommendation, termed as LazUnirec. translated_title: LazUnirec：在多场景工业推荐中统一检索与排序
translated_abstract: 现代工业推荐系统通常将检索和排序划分为两个独立的级联阶段，这导致了优化目标不一致、用户序列的冗余编码以及计算资源的浪费。以往的研究尝试使用Transformer同时建模检索和排序任务，但这些研究仍面临两个主要局限：(1) 由于检索和排序共享单一的Transformer主干网络，当两个任务的梯度方向不一致时会产生梯度冲突；(2) 当梯度冲突发生时，模型无法确定可靠的梯度更新方向。为此，我们提出了一种面向多场景工业推荐的统一检索与排序方法，称为LazUnirec。具体而言，我们在Transformer主干网络上构建任务共享参数与任务私有参数，以缓解梯度冲突。其中，对于……
tldr: LazUnirec通过在Transformer主干上构建任务共享与任务私有参数来缓解梯度冲突，实现了多场景工业推荐中检索与排序的统一建模。
en_tdlr: LazUnirec unifies retrieval and ranking in multi-scenario industrial recommendation by constructing task-shared and task-private parameters on a Transformer backbone to mitigate gradient conflicts between the two tasks.
